tests.name: Exact formatted output
tests.description: Convert north|12, south|-4, north|0 on three lines.

tests.name: Malformed records and failure locality
tests.description: Try blank line 2, extra separators, invalid name, non-canonical integer and out-of-range number.
tests.expected: ReadingFormatException with the failing line number; malformed input does not truncate output.

tests.name: Borrowed and owned resources
tests.description: Use a close-tracking Reader and a Reader that throws IOException; read/write a temporary UTF-8 file.
tests.expected: Borrowed readers remain open, I/O failure propagates, owned operations complete and resources close.

reasoning: The parser operates before the destination writer is created, so a malformed input record cannot truncate a pre-existing output. This is not a guarantee of atomic replacement if writing later fails.
Integer.toString after parsing rejects signs/leading zeros not in the declared grammar; bounds reject values outside -50..150. Parsing syntax is input validation, not grading learner source text.
parse borrows the Reader and does not close it. convert owns resources it opens, so its try-with-resources blocks close them on normal and exceptional exits.
